name: Rehobiah
title: Son of Eliezer and descendant of Moses
summary: Rehobiah was the son of Eliezer and grandson of Moses. He was head of a Levitical family that served in temple duties under King David. His descendants were very numerous and had responsibility for managing holy treasures and offerings.

keyEvents.title: Rehobiah's lineage is presented
keyEvents.description: Rehobiah is mentioned as the only son of Eliezer, son of Moses. Even though Eliezer had only one son, Rehobiah's descendants were very numerous.

keyEvents.title: Levitical service divisions under David
keyEvents.description: Rehobiah's descendants were registered as part of the Levitical service divisions when David organized temple worship.

keyEvents.title: Responsibility for the Holy Treasures
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Rehabiah, son of Shelimoth, and his brothers were in charge of all the holy treasures that King David, the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and other officers had dedicated to the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Moses
keyEvents.description: Rehabiah's lineage is traced back to Moses through his father Eliezer, giving the family a particularly prominent position among the Levites.

keyEvents.title: Rehabiah's Numerous Descendants
keyEvents.description: It is emphasized that Rehabiah's sons were very numerous, demonstrating God's blessing upon Moses' lineage through Eliezer.
